propositions: Long-running LLM gate operations (transition, review-plan, verify-completion) emit no incremental output for durations exceeding common 600s supervisor stall watchdog budgets, causing supervisors to incorrectly kill healthy runs.

Silent phases lasting 27-85+ seconds occur in prologue (material assembly, store hydration) and overlap corpus retrieval, which are local compute operations unrelated to model call time-to-first-token.
The sole shared LLM execution seam (PydanticAIRunner.run) uses non-streaming agent.run_sync with no progress instrumentation between start and final verdict at default log level.

An autonomous agent orchestrating multi-story closes was killed mid-completion after reporting it would invoke a gate; nine code changes had landed but the epic and story remained stranded in_progress, requiring manual recovery.
ADR 0089 defers a stream-event idle watchdog but does not block a separate periodic liveness emitter compatible with blocking sync code.

Existing test suite (test_llm_timeouts.py) affirmatively encodes that no total-runtime cap exists and slow-but-alive runs complete, constraining any fix to pure additive emission that does not truncate healthy long runs.
